# Upyo

> A simple and cross-runtime library for sending email messages using SMTP and various email providers

## Table of Contents

### Messages

- [Composing messages](https://upyo.org/messages/compose.md): Learn how to create email messages with Upyo's createMessage() function, including multiple recipients, rich content, priority settings, and custom headers.
- [Attachments](https://upyo.org/messages/attachments.md): Guide to adding file attachments to emails using JavaScript File objects or custom Attachment objects, including inline attachments and binary content.

### Transports

- [SMTP](https://upyo.org/transports/smtp.md): Complete guide to using Upyo's SMTP transport for universal email delivery, including connection pooling, TLS security, authentication methods, and bulk sending.
- [JMAP](https://upyo.org/transports/jmap.md): JMAP transport guide for sending emails via JMAP protocol (RFC 8620/8621), including session discovery, identity resolution, and configuration options.
- [Lettermint](https://upyo.org/transports/lettermint.md): Learn how to send emails with Lettermint transport, including batch sending, idempotency, routes, metadata, tracking settings, and inline attachments.
- [Mailgun](https://upyo.org/transports/mailgun.md): Learn how to send emails with Mailgun transport, including regional configuration, tracking and analytics, message tagging, and bulk email sending with retry logic.
- [Plunk](https://upyo.org/transports/plunk.md): Complete Plunk transport guide covering email sending, self-hosted support, message organization, batch processing, and advanced configuration for reliable delivery.
- [Resend](https://upyo.org/transports/resend.md): Complete Resend transport guide covering email sending, batch optimization, message tagging, idempotency handling, and advanced configuration for reliable delivery.
- [SendGrid](https://upyo.org/transports/sendgrid.md): Complete SendGrid transport guide covering email tracking, analytics, message tagging, bulk sending, and advanced configuration for reliable delivery.
- [Amazon SES](https://upyo.org/transports/ses.md): Amazon SES transport guide with AWS authentication, regional configuration, IAM roles, rich message features, bulk sending, and configuration sets.
- [Pool transport](https://upyo.org/transports/pool.md): Pool transport for combining multiple email providers with load balancing, failover strategies, and intelligent routing to ensure reliable email delivery.
- [Retry transport](https://upyo.org/transports/retry.md): Retry transport for wrapping Upyo transports with backoff, jitter, Retry-After handling, and sendMany throttling.
- [OpenTelemetry](https://upyo.org/transports/opentelemetry.md): Complete guide to OpenTelemetry observability for Upyo transports, including distributed tracing, metrics collection, error classification, and performance monitoring.
- [Mock transport](https://upyo.org/transports/mock.md): Testing utility transport that simulates email sending without delivery, featuring message inspection, failure simulation, and async testing patterns.
- [Custom transport](https://upyo.org/transports/custom.md): Guide to creating custom email transports for Upyo, covering the Transport interface, HTTP patterns, resource management, and best practices.


### Other

- [Getting started](https://upyo.org/start.md): A quick guide to getting started with Upyo, including installation, choosing a transport, and sending your first email.
- [Why Upyo?](https://upyo.org/why.md): Learn why Upyo is the ideal choice for email sending: cross-runtime compatibility, zero dependencies, simple API, built-in testing tools, and provider independence.
